sections.title: How the population has changed in Armagh City, Banbridge and Craigavon
sections.label: Select another local authority

sections.content: In 2024, Armagh City, Banbridge and Craigavon was the second largest local authority in Northern Ireland, with a population of just over 220,000. Its population increased by 0.3% compared with 2023, and has increased by 26.4% since 2001.

sections.title: Largest local authorities in Northern Ireland, 2001-2024
Population density in Armagh City, Banbridge and Craigavon
sections.content: In 2024, the population density in Armagh City, Banbridge and Craigavon was 166 people per square kilometre, which was more than Northern Ireland (140), and less than the United Kingdom as a whole (285).

sections.title: Densest local authorities in Northern Ireland, 2024
Median age in Armagh City, Banbridge and Craigavon
sections.content: In 2024, the median age in Armagh City, Banbridge and Craigavon was 39 years, which was younger than Northern Ireland (40 years), and younger than the United Kingdom as a whole (40 years).
